source.story: The chart room has gone dark. One lamp still glows beside the compass. Beneath it lie five wooden plates, each naming a feature from the navigator’s coastal notes. Arrange them in the only order the clues allow. Then read the first letters from left to right: together they recover the bearing missing from the chart.
source.title: The Last Bearing

hints: «Inmediatamente antes» significa que las dos tablillas deben quedar juntas.

Usa la pista que dice «antes», sin «inmediatamente», para colocar una tablilla delante del bloque. Pon la restante detrás y lee las cinco iniciales.
